data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English 'Creca's town'. Creighton is a name of Anglo-Saxon origin, meaning 'powerful, strong one'. This name has been used predominantly for boys in the English-speaking world and has strong associations with the Christian faith and the British Isles. The name Creighton carries the meaning “Powerful, strong one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Creighton usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, strong one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
